expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Removes every element from the array. Appends Str as a JSON string value. Appends I as a JSON number. Appends D as a JSON number. Removes FieldName when present. Removes every field from the object. Creates or replaces FieldName with a JSON string. Creates or replaces FieldName with a JSON number. Creates or replaces FieldName with a JSON Boolean. Stores an object value under the named field. @param FieldName Field to create or replace. @param InObject Object value to store.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void FJsonArray.Empty(); | void FJsonArray.AddString(const FString& Str); | void FJsonArray.AddNumber(int32 I); | void FJsonArray.AddNumber(float64 D); | void FJsonObject.RemoveField(const FString& FieldName); | void FJsonObject.RemoveAllFields(); | void FJsonObject.SetStringField(const FString& FieldName, const FString& StringValue); | void FJsonObject.SetNumberField(const FString& FieldName, float64 Number); | void FJsonObject.SetBoolField(const FString& FieldName, bool InValue); | void FJsonObject.SetObjectField(const FString& FieldName, const FJsonObject& InObject);
